name: PHINQS
noteEs: Especialista en base building defensivo, con foco en outposts modulares y walls perimetrales optimizadas. The Ultimate Outpost es su build flagship — double-thick perimeter, multi-layer defense, espacio de farming integrado. Recomendable para players que ya pasaron el early-game y quieren elevar su base al nivel de fortaleza.
noteEn: Specialist in defensive base building, focused on modular outposts and optimized perimeter walls. The Ultimate Outpost is his flagship build — double-thick perimeter, multi-layer defense, integrated farming space. Recommended for players past early-game who want to elevate their base to fortress level.
highlightsEs: The Ultimate Outpost: build flagship con perimeter walls double-thick
